hero.title: Driving the Transformation Toward a Sustainable Energy Future
hero.description: From a trusted building materials manufacturer to becoming part of Indonesia’s integrated energy ecosystem, Oxala remains committed to developing sustainable energy solutions through innovation, safety, and operational excellence while preserving the strong business foundation built over more than a decade.

companyOverview.title: Who We Are
companyOverview.paragraph1: PT Oxala Energy International Tbk, formerly known as PT Multi Makmur Lemindo Tbk, began its journey as a manufacturer of PVC-based building materials and was listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange through its Initial Public Offering (IPO) on April 10, 2023. In 2025, the company entered a new chapter following its acquisition by PT Morris Capital Indonesia, marking the beginning of its transformation into an integrated energy ecosystem. The company officially adopted the name PT Oxala Energy International Tbk in 2026.
companyOverview.paragraph2: Our building materials manufacturing business continues to operate while growing in synergy with the company's gradual and sustainable expansion into the energy sector.
